answer:
```cfg
# Copyright (C) 2016 Kubos Corporation
# This is an STM32F407 discovery board with a single STM32F407VGT6 chip.
# http://www.st.com/internet/evalboard/product/252419.jsp

source [find interface/stlink-v2-1.cfg]
source [find target/stm32f4x_stlink.cfg]

reset_config trst_only
gdb_memory_map disable

proc stm32f4_unlock () {
  stm32f2x unlock 0
  mww 0x40023C08 0x08192A3B
  mww 0x40023C08 0x4C5D6E7F
  mww 0x40023C14 0x0fffaaed
}

proc stm32f4_flash {file_to_flash} {
    init
    sleep 200
    reset halt
    wait_halt
    stm32f4_unlock ()
    flash write_image erase "$file_to_flash"
    reset run
    sleep 10
    shutdown
}
```

The key change for the STM32F407G-DISC1 is:

```cfg
source [find interface/stlink-v2-1.cfg]
```

instead of `interface/stlink-v2.cfg`.
